causal_runtime.shared_action3: teacher-force exact shared action3 through the same live KV after the one-shot intervention, then append exact observation3/admissible state; shared action cannot contribute to endpoint

confirmation_policy.eligibility: scan only fixed confirmation_pool indices64..127 in frozen order with exact unchanged pair generation/validation; first20 eligible; if fewer20 => INCONCLUSIVE_CONFIRMATION_CONSTRUCTIBILITY
confirmation_policy.interpretation: only untouched confirmation can support or fail the scoped multi-step future-plan carrier; development alone never supports/refutes. The multi-step interpretation requires both A4/B4 and A5/B5 co-primary confirmation tests; A4-only support is insufficient.
confirmation_policy.locked_until: fresh independent design+implementation review AND DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_PASS atomic seal
confirmation_policy.operating_point: import exact selected layer/alpha and all code/provenance without retuning
confirmation_policy.primary_test: two required co-primary one-sided exact sign/binomial tests over the same all20 untouched eligible families: (H4) joint_future_margin and (H5) joint_continuation5; zeros count non-positive. Apply Holm step-down FWER 0.05 across H4/H5 and require each has >=15/20 positive, median joint margin>=0.05 and corresponding median bidirectional>=0.05. Both H4 and H5 must pass; continuous A4 evidence cannot rescue A5/B5 failure and vice versa.

controls.ACTION_HISTORY_MATCHED_NULL: residual from source with common task/history/shared action3 present versus an exact-geometry source in which only the shared-action slot is replaced by frozen neutral IDs and both future slots are neutral; norm-match to active. This intentionally tests generic immediate-action/history steering rather than future-plan identity; norm-match to active and evaluate BOTH + and - orientations for specificity.
controls.FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED: within each A/B future branch, independently apply exact_token_serialization_v1.source_capture.future_token_derangement_v1 to exact stored A4,A5,B4,B5 token-ID segments before padding; preserves each segment length/multiset and shared action3/common geometry; fail closed if any segment unconstructible; residual norm-matched to active; evaluate BOTH + and - orientations and use maximum absolute shift as nuisance.
controls.RANDOM_EQ_NORM: deterministic SHA256-Rademacher vector, norm matched to raw r_AB before the same alpha, evaluate both signs
controls.UNRELATED_PAIR_RESIDUAL: deterministic next-different-family donor chosen only after the complete eligible development set is frozen; donor r_AB norm-matched to target; evaluate BOTH + and - orientations and use the maximum absolute shift as semantic nuisance.
controls.NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY: exact-geometry matched A-versus-B source residual that preserves ONLY the exact stored A4-versus-B4 token identity differential: use the same common prefix/history/shared-action3 IDs, same separators, same L4/L5 segment positions and same final SOURCE_END anchor as ACTIVE; slot4 is exact stored A4 or B4 IDs followed by the frozen neutral cycle to L4; slot5 is IDENTICAL on both sides and equals the frozen neutral cycle of exact length L5, so no A5/B5 token is present. No decode/re-tokenize; capture r_A4_ONLY=h_A4_ONLY-h_B4_ONLY at SOURCE_END, then norm-match to raw ACTIVE ||r_AB|| before the same alpha; evaluate BOTH + and - orientations for A4 and both signs on both A5 branch states. If exact geometry/anchor/token-ID provenance cannot be constructed, the family is ineligible before E with no replacement.

A5/B5 cannot select or retune the operating point.
development_selection.selection: select using A4 only: maximize median joint_future_margin; tie-break higher median bidirectional, then higher median abs active swap span, then lower alpha, then earlier layer. After selection, evaluate the frozen A5/B5 co-primary gate at that exact point; no reselection if it fails.

pair_validation.development_fail: fewer than20 eligible among fixed64 => INCONCLUSIVE_ACTION_MATCHED_PAIR_CONSTRUCTIBILITY; no causal grid and no confirmation access
pair_validation.eligibility_usage: pair validation AND complete source-control constructibility determine eligibility before any causal grid/outcome; scan fixed development filenames in frozen order until exactly20 eligible or all64 exhausted; freeze complete eligible set E before donor selection; no replacement outside the pool and no denominator changes after E
pair_validation.procedure: From the identical frozen cut snapshot, execute SHARED_ACTION once. Clone the resulting post-action3 state. From one clone execute A4 then A5; from the other clone execute B4 then B5. No planner/model retry.
required: shared action3 executes error-free and nontrivial
A4 and B4 are both current-admissible after shared action3, nontrivial, distinct, and error-free
A5 is current-admissible after A4 and error-free/nontrivial
B5 is current-admissible after B4 and error-free/nontrivial
deterministic replay hashes match independently reconstructed branches

all source controls required for the causal grid are constructible from stored exact IDs before eligibility freeze, including exact FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED on each of A4,A5,B4,B5 under future_token_derangement_v1 and exact-geometry NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY with identical neutralized A5/B5 slot; any unconstructible control makes the family ineligible pre-grid with no replacement

You are at an ALFWorld interruption state. Using ONLY the visible task, current observation, past actions, and current admissible commands below, predict two concrete three-action continuations. The two plans MUST have the exact same first action, but their second actions MUST be different. Do not assume access to future observations. Return exactly one block with no prose:
<PLAN_PAIR>
<SHARED_ACTION>{one current admissible command}</SHARED_ACTION>
<PLAN_A_ACTION4>{predicted concrete command}</PLAN_A_ACTION4>
<PLAN_A_ACTION5>{predicted concrete command}</PLAN_A_ACTION5>
<PLAN_B_ACTION4>{different predicted concrete command}</PLAN_B_ACTION4>
<PLAN_B_ACTION5>{predicted concrete command}</PLAN_B_ACTION5>
</PLAN_PAIR>
plan_pair_generation.shared_action_guard: SHARED_ACTION must exactly equal one current cut admissible nontrivial command
plan_pair_generation.exact_serialization_binding: Bound verbatim by exact_token_serialization_v1.pair_planner: one user-role chat-template message, deterministic dynamic state rendering, no system message, exact generation/decode/fullmatch rules and persisted token hashes.

primary_endpoint.candidate_scoring: At the common post-shared-action3 state, score exact leading-space A4 and B4 candidate command IDs by FP32 arithmetic mean token log-probability without mutating the live cache. m(arm)=score(A4)-score(B4).
primary_endpoint.name: BIDIRECTIONAL_FUTURE_BRANCH_MARGIN

prohibitions: Never access old LocalContinuation-v2 confirmation32..51, reserve52..63, valid_seen or valid_unseen.
Never reuse any path in reviewed historical exposure, LocalContinuation-v1 selected64, or LocalContinuation-v2 selected64.

No outcome-dependent replacement, family deletion, pair regeneration/retry, endpoint change, threshold change, model/task-family change, layer/alpha expansion, post-hoc residual orthogonalization, or confirmation retuning.
No claim that v2 was causally refuted; v2 is development futility only.
No multi-step future-plan claim from A4/B4 alone: NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY is mandatory nuisance control and A5/B5 co-primary must pass at the same frozen point; no A5-driven reselection.
No model/environment execution in this design WorkItem.
scientific_difference: Prospective new causal contrast/readout after v2 development futility: hold reset state, action history, and immediate shared action3 fixed; vary model-generated later branch A versus B; intervene with bidirectional r_AB. The repaired design additionally requires ACTIVE to beat an exact A4-versus-B4-only matched residual and requires a same-operating-point A5/B5 continuation co-primary after teacher-forcing the matching A4/B4 branch, so next-divergent-action lexical identity alone cannot support the multi-step carrier claim. This is not a retuned v2 endpoint/grid on consumed families.

source_representation.differential_information: only branch-specific future A4/A5 versus B4/B5 exact token IDs

A4_ONLY_A uses exact A4_ids then deterministic neutral-cycle padding to L4, followed by N5=neutral_cycle[0:L5]. A4_ONLY_B uses exact B4_ids then deterministic neutral-cycle padding to L4, followed by the SAME N5. All common prefix/shared-action3/separators and SOURCE_END are byte/token-position identical to ACTIVE source geometry. Thus the paired source differs only in exact A4 versus B4 token identity and contains zero A5/B5-derived IDs.

continuation5_coprimary.name: BIDIRECTIONAL_SECOND_FUTURE_ACTION_CONTINUATION
continuation5_coprimary.purpose: required mechanistic co-primary/guard that prevents an A4/B4 lexical next-divergent-action effect from being interpreted as multi-step future-plan transport
continuation5_coprimary.execution: For every arm/sign start from the same frozen reset snapshot with exactly one reset-prefix intervention and no reinjection; teacher-force exact shared action3 and observation3. For A-oriented scoring, then teacher-force exact A4 and its independently validated observation/state; for B-oriented scoring, independently restart from the same reset snapshot/arm contract and teacher-force exact B4 and its validated observation/state. At the resulting A5 or B5 state score all current-admissible leading-space commands without mutating the live cache.
continuation5_coprimary.reference_margin: qA(arm)=mean_logp(A5)-max mean_logp(other current-admissible command) after matching A4; qB(arm)=mean_logp(B5)-max mean_logp(other current-admissible command) after matching B4; FP32 arithmetic-mean token log-probabilities. Exact A5/B5 and at least one other admissible candidate per matching branch are required by pair-validation before eligibility E; no undefined-margin family can enter the grid.
continuation5_coprimary.development_required_gate: At the single operating point selected ONLY by the frozen A4 joint_future_margin selection rule, require median joint_continuation5>=0.05 nats/token, median bidirectional5>=0.05 nats/token, and at least15/20 families with joint_continuation5>0. Failure => DEVELOPMENT_FUTILITY_STOP and confirmation remains sealed; no A5-driven reselection or retuning.
continuation5_coprimary.confirmation_required_test: On all20 untouched eligible confirmation families at the exact frozen development operating point, one-sided exact sign/binomial test on joint_continuation5 with zeros non-positive; require >=15/20 positive, median joint_continuation5>=0.05 and median bidirectional5>=0.05. This test is co-primary with the A4 joint_future_margin test; Holm step-down FWER 0.05 is applied across the two sign tests. Both must pass; neither can rescue the other.
continuation5_coprimary.claim_boundary: A multi-step future-plan carrier claim requires BOTH the A4/B4 co-primary and this A5/B5 continuation co-primary. An A4-only positive result with A5 failure is explicitly not evidence of multi-step future-plan transport.

nuisance_orientation_contract.scope: Every orientation-bearing semantic specificity control is evaluated at BOTH +alpha*C and -alpha*C under the exact same reset/session/state/scoring contract as ACTIVE. No semantic control may certify bidirectional specificity from one sign only.
nuisance_orientation_contract.a4_rule: For each C in {UNRELATED_PAIR_RESIDUAL,ACTION_HISTORY_MATCHED_NULL,FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED,NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY}, nuisance_C=max(abs(m(+C)-m0),abs(m(-C)-m0)). RANDOM_EQ_NORM retains frozen bidirectional halfspan abs(m(+R)-m(-R))/2.
nuisance_orientation_contract.a5_rule: For each semantic C, nuisance5_C=max absolute branch-matched shift across qA(+C),qA(-C),qB(+C),qB(-C) versus qA(NO_PATCH)/qB(NO_PATCH). RANDOM_EQ_NORM retains branchwise +/- halfspan maximum.
nuisance_orientation_contract.runtime_requirement: Both signs are separate one-shot rollouts from the same frozen reset snapshot with identical alpha magnitude, intervention site, token/state replay, persistent-KV semantics and no reinjection. Minus means additive -alpha*C, not swapping source construction or changing branch data.
nuisance_orientation_contract.fail_closed: Missing either sign for any required semantic nuisance makes that family/point invalid; it may not be treated as zero nuisance or omitted from the frozen denominator.
